sentence: This project studies how circular pieces of DNA that carry cancer-causing genes form, work, move around the cell and resist treatment.
This project builds a deep learning model that designs mRNA sequences to increase protein production and make mRNA medicines work better.
This project tests whether differences among tumor cells in children with diffuse midline glioma explain why the tumors resist radiation therapy.
This project builds tools that improve how cancer imaging data are added to, described in and used from a cloud-based data repository.
This project studies immune cells called B cells in children with an autoimmune blood disorder to find out why the disease lasts a long time.
This project tries to find out why some head and neck cancer patients respond to radiation combined with immunotherapy and others do not.
This project studies how gene transcription is controlled during morphogenesis and how that control has evolved.
This project studies how activated monocytes drive harmful vascular remodeling in pulmonary arterial hypertension, using CRISPR screens and rat models.
This project tries to find genes and genetic variants that affect the risk of type 2 diabetes and to learn how they act.
This project studies how Yersinia infection reduces M cells in the small intestine and how that affects the immune response.
This project studies how filovirus proteins interact with host cell proteins, using methods such as mass spectrometry and cryoelectron microscopy.
This project studies how a small nucleolar RNA linked to obesity limits immune cell entry into breast tumors and blocks immunotherapy.
This project builds a system that uses natural language processing on social media posts to track substance use in near real time.
This project screens gene therapies that correct calcium handling in engineered heart and muscle tissues for Duchenne muscular dystrophy.
This project uses mRNA gene therapy to reactivate dormant HIV and help the immune system clear the virus.
This project builds a deep learning pipeline that models the structures of how human proteins interact with each other.
This project tests whether blocking complement signaling improves the immune attack on tumors and controls malignant effusions in recurrent epithelial ovarian cancer.
This project studies how basal progenitor cells help the laryngeal epithelium stay healthy, heal from injury and become diseased with cigarette smoke.
This project compares how well primary prevention reduces cardiovascular and cancer problems in adults with breast cancer.
